component.name: Clipboard History
component.summary: مدیر کلیپ‌بورد مدرن برای لینوکس با الهام از ویندوز ۱۱

description.p: A fast, bilingual clipboard manager for Linux (Wayland & X11), inspired by the Windows 11 Win+V clipboard experience. Built with Tauri v2, React 19, and Rust for maximum performance and security.
مدیر کلیپ‌بورد سریع و دوزبانه برای لینوکس (Wayland و X11) با الهام از تجربه Win+V ویندوز ۱۱. ساخته شده با Tauri v2، React 19 و Rust.

ul.li: Super+V / Ctrl+Alt+V shortcut to open clipboard history
Persian (فارسی) + English bilingual UI with instant RTL
Pin important items, emoji picker, kaomoji, and symbols
Local SQLite history with secret filter and privacy controls
Acrylic/glass UI with light, dark, and system theme support
Image clipboard support with thumbnail previews

description.p: Production release with SQLite persistence, privacy filters, SSRF protection, and bilingual UI.
